SUMMARY OF ABBREVIATIONS
PAE Post-Antibiotic Effect

I. INTRODUCTION
● The oldest and most famous book on war is the Art of War.
II. DEFINITION OF TERMS 🔺
A. ANTIBIOTICS
● Substances produced by one microorganism that kill or
prevent the growth of another microorganism
<<<page 2>>>
III. FACTORS TO CONSIDER IN THE RATIONAL CHOICE OF
ANTIMICROBIALS
● Factors related to the organism, the epidemiology, and the host.
IV. WEAPONS AND AMMUNITION AGAINST INFECTIOUS
ORGANISMS
● Antimicrobials are the weapons; doses are the ammunition.
V. THE MOLECULAR BASIS OF CHEMOTHERAPY
● Targets differ between microbial and human cells.
<<<page 3>>>
VI. GENERAL CLASSIFICATION OF ANTIMICROBIALS
● By mechanism, mode, spectrum, and toxicity.
VII. REASONS FOR USING COMBINATIONS OF ANTIMICROBIAL
AGENTS
● Synergy and prevention of resistance.
VIII. ANTIMICROBIAL PROPHYLAXIS
● Given before exposure in selected situations.
IX. REASONS FOR ANTIMICROBIAL FAILURE
● Wrong drug, wrong dose, or resistant organism.
X. RATIONAL THERAPEUTIC STRATEGY FOR PROVEN OR
UNSUSPECTED INFECTIOUS DISEASES
● Culture first, then narrow the regimen.
